purpose: offline fisheye-model feasibility; no production activation
stop_reason: All matched fisheye folds exceed the 2 px diagnostic training-residual bound; view-009 prospective residual is worse than frozen Brown; OpenCV 5.0.0 Python omits fisheye flag constants and returned skew is nonzero despite FIX_SKEW. No coefficient tuning was performed.
validation_protocol: For views 001–008, hold out each entire view from intrinsics, estimate pose from parity 0 then score parity 1, swap and concatenate. Separately fit on views 001–008 only and score view-009 with the same parity split.
validation_limit: Held-out pose uses other corners from that same view. Reprojection consistency on checkerboard captures is not independent XY accuracy.

brown_eight_view_leave_one_out.purpose: offline lens-model feasibility; no production activation
brown_eight_view_leave_one_out.validation_protocol: Hold out entire view from intrinsics/lens fit; estimate its pose on checkerboard parity 0, score parity 1; swap and concatenate.
brown_eight_view_leave_one_out.validation_limit: Other corners of the held-out image fit pose, so this tests projection consistency with unseen poses, not independently measured table XY or ball centers. Neighboring corner errors may be correlated.
limitations: Small target and limited tilt diversity can make intrinsics weakly identified despite low pixel residuals.
Physical pitch/flatness uncertainty, JPEG and corner detection systematic errors are not estimated.
No table millimeter or ball-center accuracy is established; no Z ball output is introduced.
No corrected-image preview is emitted: parameter plausibility alone does not justify a visually persuasive warp.
Model comparison is preflight evidence, not permission to select the lowest residual or activate a calibration.

fisheye_eight_view_leave_one_out.fit_model: OpenCV fisheye theta-polynomial with four coefficients

brown_view009_frozen.validation_protocol: Frozen full-training-set intrinsics and lens parameters; held-out view pose estimated from one corner parity and evaluated on the other, then swapped.
brown_view009_frozen.limitations: One new image probes projection consistency at one placement. It does not prove table XY/ball-center accuracy, establish physical uncertainty, or justify selecting a more complex model from this result alone.

limitations: The 9-view checkerboard target has small projected square pitch and limited tilt coverage; model parameters can be weakly identified.
Fisheye fit instability is not proof the camera has zero fisheye distortion or that the pinhole model is physically exact.
Cushion samples follow visible transitions that may include shadow, seams, or cloth texture; they are not surveyed physical rails.
Cushion extraction variants are correlated sensitivity probes, not independent confidence bounds.
No ball-center accuracy, table millimeter accuracy, live latency, or selected FPS is established.
No ball height/depth/Z estimate, camera capture, new physical measurement, or production profile activation is included.
